item.title: Expertise in Electronic Manufacturing and Assembly Solutions
item.description:
Our Commitment to Electronic Manufacturing Excellence
#

Established in Taichung, Taiwan in 2002, Funet Technology Inc. has grown into a trusted provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS) and contract manufacturing. Certified with ISO-9001, ISO-13485, and ISO 14001, we have dedicated over two decades to serving the ODM and OEM needs of the medical, industrial, and consumer electronics markets.
